requirements.quote: Sponsor-selected configuration for one new raffle.
requirements.checkable: The sponsor can select the new raffle's recipient, prize, reserve, and timing parameters, subject to validation.

requirements.quote: Immutable recipient of sponsor quote proceeds and any returned prize.
requirements.checkable: A raffle's configured sponsorRecipient cannot change after creation.

requirements.quote: Immutable recipient of sponsor quote proceeds and any returned prize.

requirements.quote: Immutable recipient of sponsor quote proceeds and any returned prize.

requirements.quote: Standards-compliant ERC-721 prize contract.
requirements.checkable: The configured prizeToken is a standards-compliant ERC-721 contract; this interface does not enumerate conformance criteria.

requirements.quote: Token ID to escrow atomically during creation.
requirements.checkable: Creation atomically escrows the configured prizeTokenId from the configured prizeToken contract.

requirements.quote: Global raw entry-count threshold selecting the NFT outcome when met or exceeded.
requirements.checkable: The NFT outcome is selected when the raffle's global raw entry count is greater than or equal to reserveEntries.

requirements.quote: Exclusive sale-end
requirements.checkable: Sales are no longer permitted at or after endTime.

requirements.quote: Unix timestamp, in seconds.
requirements.checkable: endTime is interpreted as Unix time in seconds.

requirements.quote: Emitted after a raffle clone is initialized, registered, funded, and active.
requirements.checkable: Successful raffle creation emits RaffleCreated.

requirements.quote: Emitted after a raffle clone is initialized, registered, funded, and active.
requirements.checkable: RaffleCreated is emitted only after the clone has been initialized.

requirements.quote: Emitted after a raffle clone is initialized, registered, funded, and active.

requirements.quote: One-based canonical raffle identifier.

requirements.checkable: RaffleCreated.raffleId equals the canonical identifier assigned to the emitted raffle address.

requirements.quote: Newly created fixed-target ERC-1167 clone.

requirements.checkable: A created clone's implementation target cannot change.

requirements.quote: Newly created fixed-target ERC-1167 clone.
requirements.checkable: Created raffle clones conform to ERC-1167.

requirements.quote: Prize depositor
requirements.checkable: RaffleCreated.sponsor identifies the prize depositor.

requirements.quote: pre-end empty-raffle refund authority.
requirements.checkable: The sponsor is authorized to trigger a refund before endTime when the raffle is empty.

requirements.quote: Immutable recipient of sponsor quote proceeds and any returned prize.
requirements.checkable: RaffleCreated.sponsorRecipient equals the new raffle's configured sponsorRecipient.

requirements.quote: ERC-721 contract of the escrowed prize.
requirements.checkable: RaffleCreated.prizeToken identifies the contract of the prize actually escrowed.

requirements.quote: Token ID of the escrowed prize.
requirements.checkable: RaffleCreated.prizeTokenId identifies the token actually escrowed.

requirements.quote: Immutable canonical six-decimal USDC contract used by the raffle.
requirements.checkable: RaffleCreated.quoteToken equals the quote-token address used by the new raffle.

requirements.quote: Immutable recipient of protocol fees.
requirements.checkable: RaffleCreated.protocolTreasury equals the new raffle's protocol-fee recipient.

requirements.quote: Global raw entry-count threshold selecting the NFT outcome when met or exceeded.
requirements.checkable: RaffleCreated.reserveEntries equals the new raffle's configured reserve-entry threshold.

requirements.quote: Exclusive sale-end Unix timestamp, in seconds.
requirements.checkable: RaffleCreated.endTime equals the new raffle's configured sale-end timestamp.

requirements.quote: Raised when a required address is the zero address.
requirements.checkable: ZeroAddress is raised for a zero value in a required address; this interface does not enumerate all addresses covered.

requirements.quote: Raised when an address required to contain deployed code is not a contract.
requirements.checkable: NotContract is raised when an address requiring deployed code has none; this interface does not enumerate all such addresses.

requirements.quote: Address whose code length was zero.
requirements.checkable: NotContract.account is the offending address whose code length was zero.

requirements.quote: Raised when the quote token cannot report its decimal precision.

requirements.quote: Rejected quote-token contract.
requirements.checkable: UnsupportedQuoteToken.quoteToken identifies the rejected quote-token contract.

requirements.quote: Raised when the quote token does not use the required six-decimal precision.
requirements.checkable: InvalidQuoteTokenDecimals is raised when the quote token reports a decimal precision other than six.

requirements.checkable: InvalidQuoteTokenDecimals.actualDecimals equals the precision reported by the rejected quote token.

requirements.quote: Required decimal precision, exactly six.
requirements.checkable: InvalidQuoteTokenDecimals.requiredDecimals equals six.

requirements.quote: Raised when the prize contract does not report ERC-721 interface support.

requirements.quote: Raised when a raffle is configured with a zero reserve entry threshold.

requirements.quote: Raised when the sale end is not strictly after the creation block timestamp.
requirements.checkable: InvalidEndTime is raised when endTime is less than or equal to the creation block timestamp.

requirements.quote: Supplied exclusive sale-end Unix timestamp, in seconds.
requirements.checkable: InvalidEndTime.endTime equals the supplied sale-end timestamp in Unix seconds.

requirements.quote: Raised when the prospective sale duration exceeds the fixed 30-day limit.
requirements.checkable: SaleDurationTooLong is raised when the prospective duration, endTime minus the creation block timestamp, exceeds 30 days.

requirements.quote: Prospective sale duration in seconds.
requirements.checkable: SaleDurationTooLong.duration reports the prospective sale duration in seconds.

requirements.quote: Maximum permitted sale duration in seconds.
requirements.checkable: SaleDurationTooLong.maximumDuration reports the fixed maximum of 30 days expressed in seconds.
